latestVersion.changelog:
Kite AI Agent Wallet Protocol initial release:

- Enables AI agents to create and manage smart wallets on the Kite AI Testnet.
- Provides modular, extensible wallet architecture with support for session keys and programmable spending limits.
- Features layered permissions (owner, agent, session key) and robust security controls, including session key revocation and module isolation.
- Includes deployed smart contract addresses for the Kite AI Testnet.
- Offers developer usage examples and main/testnet configuration details.
